summary: Explains configuring /etc/krb5.conf to find the KDC via DNS SRV records (dns_lookup_kdc) or by manually listing realms, KDCs and domain_realm mappings.
questions: How do I configure krb5.conf for Ansible to reach my domain?
How does Kerberos find the domain controller?
How do I hard-code KDCs in krb5.conf instead of using DNS?

answer_card.title: Configuring krb5.conf
answer_card.answer_md:
DNS-based lookup:

```ini
[libdefaults]
    default_realm = MY.DOMAIN.COM
    dns_lookup_kdc = true
```

This looks up `_kerberos._udp` / `_kerberos._tcp` SRV records. Manual config:

```ini
[libdefaults]
    default_realm = MY.DOMAIN.COM
    dns_lookup_kdc = false
[realms]
    MY.DOMAIN.COM = {
        kdc = domain-controller1.my.domain.com
        kdc = domain-controller2.my.domain.com
    }
[domain_realm]
    .my.domain.com = MY.DOMAIN.COM
    my.domain.com = MY.DOMAIN.COM
```
